page.title: v2.4.0 launch notes
page.body:
## What's new in 2.4
- **Per-Dot permissions.** Turn browser, files and shell on or off for each coworker. Everything starts off.
- **Activity log.** See every computer action, who asked for it and whether it was allowed.
- **Page revision checks.** A changed draft goes back for review before it is saved.

## Fixes
11 fixes, mostly around autosave and reconnects.
